links.outcome: Multimodal LLM diagnostic performance identifying ECGs warranting cath lab activation vs cardiology decisions
links.effect: Gemini sensitivity 95.3% but specificity 9.4%; ChatGPT and Claude sensitivity 68.1% and 67.2%, specificity 42.3% and 46.5%; ECG machine algorithm sensitivity 67.7%, specificity 64.2%.
links.quote: Multimodal LLM interpretation of prehospital ECGs demonstrated clinically unreliable performance for identifying ECGs warranting emergent cardiac catheterization laboratory activation when benchmarked against real-world cardiology activation decisions.

links.outcome: LLM performance compared against existing ECG machine algorithm on same ECGs
links.effect: ECG machine algorithm had sensitivity 67.7% and higher specificity (64.2%) than all LLMs; LLMs did not outperform the existing software.
links.quote: The ECG machine algorithm demonstrated more balanced performance, with sensitivity of 67.7% (95% CI 61.4-73.4) and higher specificity (64.2%) than all LLMs.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation/benchmark of multimodal LLMs interpreting prehospital ECGs compared to machine algorithms and real-world activation decisions.
